Sandrone, also known by her personal name Marionette Guillotin and codename "Marionette,"[2] is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact.

She is the Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and the leader of the Adventurers' Guild. She interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

Sandrone was created by Alain Guillotin in the image of his deceased sister, Mary-Ann Guillotin. Following Alain's death, she kept Pulonia, his final creation, as her constant companion.[6][11] Since Pulonia's death, she has been accompanied by a new robotic companion named Fagio (Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache).

Upon obtaining Sandrone, the World Quest A Lady's Invitation becomes available, and completing it rewards Sandrone's Portable Tea Table.

Normal Attack
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "Fagio," and switches it to DecodingDecodingFagio will switch to this mode when using a Charged Attack.
When in this mode, Fagio will engage any opponents ahead with a sweeping fire attack, as well as fire condensed beams at intervals, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer DMG. mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

While in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding PowerDecoding PowerWhen in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power will continuously increase. When its Decoding Power reaches the maximum, Fagio will be unable to maintain or re-enter Decoding mode. will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to Power Overdrive mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing Cryo DMG. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits Power Overdrive mode when its Decoding Power has decreased to under 50.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.

With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing Cryo DMG.

Talent Demo[]

TitleDescription
Character SummarySandrone is a Cryo DMG dealer who enables her teammates to trigger Stellar-Conduct reactions and who deals Stellar-Conduct DMG directly with her Talents.
During a Charged Attack, Sandrone will also summon the mechanism "Fagio" to bombard the opponent. During this time, Fagio's Power will rise continuously, and once it reaches its max limit, Fagio will overheat and slow down its rate of attack.
When Sandrone unleashes the Elemental Skill , she will fire Prism Shots at any opponents nearby, as well as lower Fagio's Power so that it can continue to bombard the opponent.
When she unleashes her Elemental Burst , Sandrone will summon a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for an elegant wide-area bombardment in front of her.
Stellar-Conduct ReactionWhen Sandrone is in the party, Superconduct reactions triggered by party members will be converted to Stellar-Conduct reactions. A Starlight Prism will appear on the field, turning the surrounding area into a wondrous Polestar Field for a short period of time.
All characters inside the Polestar Field receive a Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus, and when opponents within the field are hit by Cryo or Electro attacks, the field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 4s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 4s.
Additionally, opponents within the Polestar Field will also have their Physical RES reduced.

Change History[]

Introduced in Version 1.0 • Released in Version "Luna VIII"
[Edit History]
Version "Luna VIII"
  • Sandrone was released as a playable character.

Version "Luna I"

  • Sandrone appeared as a quest-exclusive NPC named Marionette in Archon Quest Where the Moon Rises in Song of the Welkin Moon: Act I - A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves.

Version 5.8

  • Sandrone was introduced as an unnamed quest-exclusive NPC (voice-only) in Archon Quest Smoldering in Song of the Welkin Moon: Prelude - The Journey Home.

Version 2.8

  • Sandrone was mentioned in Tartaglia's character voice-over: "About Marionette."

Version 2.7

  • July 11, 2022:
    • Sandrone's appearance was revealed in Teyvat Chapter Interlude Teaser: A Winter Night's Lazzo.

Version 1.0

  • November 5, 2020:
    • Sandrone was introduced in the description of Tartaglia's Character Tale, "Childe: Sigil of Permission."
